executiveSummary.headline: Bridge Formal Meeting Metrics to W Rome’s Broader Private-Event Offer
executiveSummary.lead: W Rome appears in 20 of 48 eligible scenarios and ranks third among six certified Marriott Bonvoy peers, but AI Consideration is 11.5%. Its official pages show a differentiated lifestyle proposition—148 rooms and suites, rooftop dining, W Lounge, WET Deck, private-event venues, design, and city programming—while several of those assets remain absent or weak in the certified attribute read.
executiveSummary.metricsNote: AI Consideration is the share of comparable monitored answers mentioning the hotel; Scenario Presence is the share of eligible traveler-need scenarios where it appeared. Certified Peer Position uses the named governed peer set. These measures do not represent bookings, ADR, revenue, or traveler exposure.

themes.title: Bridge Formal Meeting Metrics to Private-Event Capacities
themes.what: The events headline lists 2 event rooms, 60 square meters, and a largest-space capacity of 40. The same page separately offers W Lounge and Giardino Clandestino for up to 100 standing, WET Deck for 90, and other private-event settings.
themes.whyItMatters: A clear formal-room versus buyout/ancillary-venue bridge helps planners compare the right capacity frame.

themes.title: Publish One Dining and Social-Venue Category Map
themes.what: Official copy presents Giano, Citrico Rooftop, Zucchero, W Lounge, and Giardino Clandestino across dining and social contexts, while the amenity headline states four restaurants and one bar.
themes.whyItMatters: Stable categories help guests and partners distinguish restaurants, bars, lounges, pastry concepts, and seasonal spaces.

themes.title: Strengthen Restaurant, Pool, Pet, and Lifestyle Facts
themes.what: ADP recorded 0% for on-site restaurant, small meeting space, private dining, pet friendly, and lifestyle; outdoor pool recognition was 1.4%, despite detailed official content.
themes.whyItMatters: Consistent facts can improve buyer context without promising a change in AI rank, bookings, ADR, or revenue.
